summary: Executed 17 public backend API tests and end-to-end Playwright coverage for onboarding, uploads, AI study tools, Feynman helpers, correction, planner, radar, duel, library, and questions. AI and object-storage integrations passed; found two state/validation defects.

critical.issue: A newly created topic is persisted with next_due one day ahead, so GET immediately returns is_due=false instead of keeping it in HOJE NO RADAR.

ui_bugs.issue: Entrar no EduBoost remains enabled with zero selected subjects and all 12 subjects can be selected, despite the requested minimum of 2 and the UI text saying up to 4.

integration_issues.issue: The frontend locally forces is_due=true after adding a topic, but after page reload the backend response makes the unreviewed topic move from HOJE NO RADAR to PRÓXIMAS REVISÕES.

action_items: Persist new revision topics as due now; only schedule a future next_due after the first review, then remove the frontend-only is_due override.
Enforce onboarding focus-subject bounds (minimum 2, maximum 4) and disable submission with an explanatory validation message outside that range.
Retest Radar across reload and onboarding boundary selections after fixes.
critical_code_review_comments: storage.py uses synchronous requests calls from async FastAPI handlers, blocking the event loop during object-storage init/upload/download; use an async HTTP client or run the blocking calls in a worker thread.
Revision due state has two sources of truth: server next_due/is_due and a frontend-created is_due=true override. Derive this state consistently from the backend.
Planner PATCH and delete endpoints, plus material/revision deletes, do not return 404 for unknown IDs and do not scope mutations by session_id; validate ownership/existence before mutating.
Onboarding toggleSubject has no subject-count validation even though product copy specifies a maximum and the requested flow requires at least two.
seed_data_creation: Created isolated TEST_/Ana QA profiles, one PNG material, planner task, and radar topics; test material and test profiles were removed after execution, while API CRUD fixtures cleaned their own records.
context_for_next_testing_agent: GPT-5.6 Terra text/JSON endpoints and Terra Vision all responded successfully. Study upload persisted to Mongo/object storage and exact bytes downloaded. Planner CRUD/progress, Radar immediate add/review, Duel, Library, Questions, Feynman, and Correction passed. Reproduce Radar defect by adding a topic, reloading, navigating back to Radar: it appears under upcoming without review. One initial Feynman helper automation assertion was corrected to wait beyond the temporary '...gerando' state; the retest passed.
rca_of_the_issue: Radar: add_revision_topic stores next_due=next_due(0), which adds one day; list_revision therefore calculates is_due=false. Revision.jsx masks this only in memory with {...data, is_due:true}, so reload exposes the server state. Onboarding: toggleSubject blindly appends/removes values and submit has no count guard or disabled condition.
